problem_statement: Add composable decorator classes for stream handles in the Psl\IO package: ConcatReadHandle, FixedLengthReadHandle, BoundedReadHandle, TruncatedReadHandle, TeeWriteHandle, JoinedReadWriteHandle, SinkReadHandle, SinkWriteHandle, SinkReadWriteHandle. Implementations must follow existing Psl\IO interfaces and convenience traits, close underlying CloseHandleInterface handles, and replace ad-hoc duplicate wrappers. Implement the classes under packages/io/src/Psl/IO/, add test fixtures under packages/io/tests/fixture/, and register the fixture namespace in composer autoload-dev so they resolve through the root project autoloader.
problem_statement_variant: The stream package is missing reusable building blocks for composing reads and writes. A developer currently has to write custom wrappers for every bounded read, concatenated read, or mirrored write. Please add a small, coherent set of composable stream decorators in the IO package that cover these patterns and make them available through normal autoloading.
hints: Study packages/io/src/Psl/IO/ReadHandleInterface.php, WriteHandleInterface.php, ReadWriteHandleInterface.php, ReadHandleConvenienceMethodsTrait.php, WriteHandleConvenienceMethodsTrait.php, MemoryHandle.php, IterableReadHandle.php. New classes belong in packages/io/src/Psl/IO/. Test doubles (fixtures) go in packages/io/tests/fixture/ under the Psl\IO\Tests\Fixture namespace and must be registered in the root composer.json autoload-dev (dependent-package autoload-dev is not merged into the root autoloader).
